comparison: Four-arm A/B on ARC-AGI-3 ls20: reactive baseline vs EWM text-only vs EWM vision (qwen35b-arc, PRE-fix harness) vs EWM vision (qwen-coding, FIXED probe-first harness)
harness_note: Arms 1-3 ran on the PRE-fix harness where a program could be adopted vacuously (validated against zero transitions at cold start). Arm 4 runs on the FIXED harness (probe-first seeding: min_probe_transitions=4, adoption requires validate() pass on a NON-EMPTY suite; plus repair caps and a live pass-rate floor 0.5/last-20 -> reactive fallback). Adoption semantics therefore DIFFER between arm 3 and arm 4: arm 3's program_adopted:true was vacuous; arm 4's program_adopted:false means 4 real synthesis attempts each failed validation against observed transitions and the harness correctly refused adoption.

ewm_vision_qwen35b_arc_prefix.note_adoption: VACUOUS: adopted against zero transitions at cold start (pre-fix rule), then mispredicted all 80 observed transitions (divergences=80, empirical pass rate 0.0).

ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.model: qwen-coding:latest (qwen35moe 36B, vision-capable, num_ctx 65536, ollama) as BOTH gameplay and synthesis
ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.harness: FIXED (probe-first seeding + repair caps + live pass-rate floor). program_adopted here is NOT comparable to arm 3: false means candidates were tested against a real non-empty suite and all failed validation.
ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.live_pass_rate: 1.0 (VACUOUS -- window only scores against an adopted program; none was adopted, so the empty-window default 1.0 is reported)
ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.best_pass_rate: no candidate program passed validate() on the seeded suite (0/4 synthesis attempts adopted)
ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.note_divergences: field counts reactive_turns, not model divergences: 80 actions = 4 probe-seeding actions + 76 reactive fallback turns; zero expect-mismatches because no program was ever executed

delta.levels_completed: 0 vs 0 vs 0 vs 0 (four-way tie: no arm cleared any of the 7 levels)
delta.actions_taken: baseline 51, text-only 70, vision pre-fix 80, vision fixed 80 (each hit its own action/wall cap)
delta.program_adopted: only arm 3 adopted -- and vacuously; arm 4's non-adoption is the fixed harness correctly refusing 4 non-validating candidates, which is the intended behavior, not a regression
delta.synthesis_engagement: arm 2: synthesis never produced an adoptable program (text-only model could not author from raw grids); arm 3: synthesis engaged and adopted vacuously; arm 4: synthesis engaged 4 times against a real 80-transition suite, all candidates failed validation

verdict: TRUTHFUL FOUR-ARM FAILED A/B. All four arms completed 0 of 7 ls20 levels. Arm 4 (qwen-coding, both roles, vision on, FIXED probe-first harness) is the first arm where the world-model machinery behaved fully honestly end-to-end: probe seeding banked 4 real transitions before any synthesis, SYNTHESIZE engaged 4 times against a non-empty suite that grew to 80 transitions, and every candidate program failed validate() -- so the harness refused adoption and fell back to reactive play (76 reactive turns), exactly as designed. Contrast with arm 3, where the pre-fix harness adopted a program against zero evidence and then watched it miss all 80 transitions. Net: the fix converted 'confidently wrong world model' into 'no world model, honest fallback' -- same level score, better epistemics. The remaining bottleneck is unchanged and now cleanly isolated: neither local 35B-class model can yet author a Python program that reproduces real ls20 dynamics, whether validated before (arm 4) or after (arm 3) adoption. Telemetry caveats recorded on arm 4: live_pass_rate=1.0 is the vacuous empty-window default (no adopted program to score), and divergences=76 counts reactive turns, not expect-mismatches.
pair_recommendation: For the Kaggle two-local-model pair: use qwen-coding:latest as the SYNTHESIS model and qwen35b-arc:latest as the GAMEPLAY (+vision) model. Rationale, stated with its evidential limits: qwen-coding is the only model observed emitting candidate programs under the fixed harness's real validation gate (4 attempts, parseable fenced programs, no thinking-drain with reasoning_effort:none), making it the better-evidenced synthesis half even though none of its candidates validated yet; qwen35b-arc showed the sharper multimodal grounding in sanity checks (named the exact changed cell+color on the composite, where qwen-coding was off-by-one on a 3x3), making it the better-evidenced gameplay/vision half. CAVEAT: no arm has run qwen35b-arc on the fixed harness, and no arm has cleared a level, so this recommendation ranks failure modes rather than successes; a qwen35b-arc-synthesis arm on the fixed harness would be the decisive missing data point.
